ammonia.reason: Penicillium protease-deaminase proteolysis releases NH3 raising pH to ~6.8

animal_barnyard.reason: Low p-cresol/indole in pasteurized cow milk clean Penicillium ripening

bitter.reason: Hydrophobic peptides from rennet plus Penicillium proteinases, milder in dolce type

browning.reason: Maillard of residual lactose with lysine plus fat browning on heating

buttery.reason: Diacetyl/acetoin from citrate fermentation by Lactococcus/Streptococcus starters

cheesy_sweaty.reason: Penicillium roqueforti/glaucum lipases release butyric/hexanoic free fatty acids

creaminess.reason: 29-31% fat plus proteolytic softening gives creamy dolce paste

crumbliness.reason: High-moisture proteolyzed paste fractures short but not dry-crumbly

firmness.reason: 42-50% moisture pierced semi-soft paste softened by mold proteolysis

floral_honey.reason: Phenylacetaldehyde 643 ug/kg from phenylalanine Strecker degradation

fruity.reason: Methyl/ethyl esters including methyl propanoate plus methyl ketones by esterases

goaty.reason: C6:0-C8:0 caproic-caprylic acids from milk-fat lipolysis, moderate in cow milk

malty_nutty.reason: 3-methylbutanal 1120 ug/kg and 3-methyl-1-butanol 2534 ug/kg from leucine catabolism

melt.reason: Rennet gel at pH ~6.65 with intact para-casein flows on heating

mushroom_earthy.reason: 1-octen-3-ol 601 ug/kg from linoleic acid oxidation by Penicillium lipoxygenase

oil_off.reason: High fat with mold-loosened protein network releases free oil on melting

smoky.reason: No smoking step and no guaiacol/volatile phenols detected

sour_vinegar.reason: Lactic/acetic acids consumed/neutralized during blue ripening to pH ~6.6-6.8

stretch.reason: No pasta-filata hot-water kneading so casein not aligned for stringing

sulfur_cooked.reason: Only trace methional/sulfides from methionine catabolism reported in Gorgonzola

sweet.reason: Residual lactose plus sweet amino acids balanced by salt and ketones

umami.reason: Extensive mold proteolysis to glutamate and savory peptides over >3 mo
